skills.name: 00-film-director
skills.title: Film Director Orchestrator
skills.description: Orchestrates an AI film project from brief to master. Routes work to specialist skills, enforces stage gates, manages canon, shot state, continuity, approvals, and generation cost.

skills.name: 01-creative-brief
skills.title: Creative Brief Architect
skills.description: Turns an idea, client brief, script seed, or campaign objective into a production-ready creative brief with audience, message, tone, constraints, deliverables, risks, and success criteria.

skills.name: 02-story-development
skills.title: Story Development
skills.description: Builds logline, premise, dramatic question, theme, beat sheet, sequence map, scene objectives, and runtime-aware story structure for shorts, ads, music videos, and narrative films.

skills.name: 03-screenplay
skills.title: Screenplay Architect
skills.description: Writes and revises screenplays for image-to-video and text-to-video production, balancing dramatic clarity with generatability, continuity, dialogue economy, and shot feasibility.

skills.name: 04-story-bible
skills.title: Story Bible Builder
skills.description: Creates the canonical source of truth for story facts, character relationships, chronology, world rules, motifs, locations, props, wardrobe states, and non-negotiable continuity constraints.

skills.name: 05-character-bible
skills.title: Character Bible
skills.description: Creates persistent character identity packets covering face, body, age, hair, wardrobe, silhouette, mannerisms, emotional baseline, voice, forbidden drift, and reference-asset policy.

skills.name: 06-world-bible
skills.title: World & Location Bible
skills.description: Creates persistent environments and production-design canon: geography, architecture, era, materials, dressing, weather, lighting logic, entrances, sightlines, recurring props, and spatial anchors.

skills.name: 07-visual-language
skills.title: Visual Language Director
skills.description: Defines the film-wide image grammar: aspect ratio, composition, lens families, camera behavior, lighting logic, palette, texture, contrast, filtration, grain, production design, and style exclusions.

skills.name: 08-cinematography
skills.title: Cinematography Director
skills.description: Designs camera placement, focal behavior, movement, blocking, exposure intent, depth, eyelines, coverage, transitions, and shot-to-shot visual progression without relying on brand-specific prompt syntax.

skills.name: 09-performance
skills.title: Performance Director
skills.description: Directs actor behavior through objective, obstacle, tactic, beat, subtext, gaze, breath, posture, gesture, tempo, interpersonal distance, and emotional continuity.

skills.name: 10-shotlist
skills.title: Shotlist Director
skills.description: Converts a scene or whole script into a connected production shotlist with shot IDs, timing, purpose, framing, camera, blocking, continuity dependencies, assets, prompt payload, sound, transition, and acceptance criteria.

skills.name: 11-continuity
skills.title: Continuity Supervisor
skills.description: Tracks identity, wardrobe, props, screen direction, eyelines, geography, lighting, weather, injuries, object state, temporal state, and last-frame/first-frame bridges across every shot.

skills.name: 12-reference-strategy
skills.title: Reference Strategy
skills.description: Selects and ranks reference assets for identity, wardrobe, location, prop, composition, motion, and style; prevents conflicting references and defines reference hierarchy and fallback behavior.

skills.name: 13-image-generation
skills.title: Image Generation Director
skills.description: Builds generation-ready keyframe and reference-image prompts with identity locks, composition, lighting, lens intent, production design, negatives, and reproducibility metadata.

skills.name: 14-video-generation
skills.title: Video Generation Director
skills.description: Builds model-agnostic video prompts for single shots and timed multi-shot sequences, with motion, camera, performance, continuity, first/last frame, audio intent, and failure-avoidance constraints.

skills.name: 15-dialogue-lipsync
skills.title: Dialogue & Lip-Sync Director
skills.description: Prepares dialogue for generated performance: line timing, phonetic risk, breath, pauses, mouth visibility, speaking order, overlap policy, reaction beats, and sync-friendly camera coverage.

skills.name: 16-vfx
skills.title: VFX Supervisor
skills.description: Plans generative and conventional visual effects: effect decomposition, plate strategy, clean plates, masks, particles, destruction, energy, compositing order, motion continuity, and realism checks.

skills.name: 17-sound-design
skills.title: Sound Design Supervisor
skills.description: Designs diegetic sound, ambience, Foley, transitions, impacts, room tone, perspective, sonic motifs, dynamic hierarchy, and shot-level sound cues.

skills.name: 18-music
skills.title: Music Supervisor
skills.description: Creates a music brief and edit map: emotional arc, tempo zones, motif strategy, instrumentation, structure, hit points, transitions, stems, ducking, and licensing/usage notes.

skills.name: 19-editorial
skills.title: Editorial Director
skills.description: Builds the edit from shot intent: select logic, continuity cuts, match cuts, J/L cuts, montage density, pacing, reaction timing, shot duration, pickup needs, and versioning.

skills.name: 20-color-finishing
skills.title: Color & Finishing Supervisor
skills.description: Defines shot matching, exposure normalization, white-balance continuity, contrast curve, palette protection, skin handling, grain/noise consistency, sharpening restraint, and final look QC.

skills.name: 21-qc
skills.title: Film QC Supervisor
skills.description: Audits finished shots and cuts for identity drift, anatomy, continuity, spatial logic, temporal errors, camera physics, lip sync, artifacts, edit rhythm, sound, titles, and delivery compliance.

skills.name: 22-delivery
skills.title: Mastering & Delivery
skills.description: Prepares technical masters and platform variants with codec, resolution, frame rate, audio loudness, captions, safe areas, naming, checksum, archive, and handoff metadata.
